title: Sr. HR Recruiter
description:
Job Title: HR Recruiter – In\-house Recruitment

Industry: Oil \& Gas / Engineering / EPC

Job Type: Full\-Time \| In\-house Recruitment

Location:Ramwadi Pune

Experience:3–5Years

Qualification: Graduate / MBA in HR or equivalent

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced HR Recruiter to manage end\-to\-end recruitment activities for our Oil \& Gas organization. The candidate will be responsible for sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, and closing positions across technical and non\-technical functions.

Key Responsibilities

Manage the complete end\-to\-end recruitment process from sourcing to onboarding.

Understand manpower requirements and prepare effective recruitment strategies.

Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, and other channels.

Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate interviews.

Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and candidates.

Follow up with candidates throughout the selection process.

Manage salary negotiations and offer discussions.

Maintain recruitment trackers, MIS reports, and candidate databases.

Ensure timely closure of open positions as per manpower requirements.

Coordinate documentation and joining formalities.

Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for critical and recurring positions.

Preferred Skills

Good knowledge of Oil \& Gas / EPC / Engineering recruitment.

Experience hiring technical profiles such as Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Piping, Civil, Process, QA/QC, HSE, Project, and Maintenance professionals.

Strong sourcing and screening skills.

Good communication and interpersonal skills.

Strong follow\-up and coordination abilities.

Knowledge of recruitment portals and LinkedIn.

Good working knowledge of MS Excel and recruitment MIS.

Key Competencies

Recruitment \| Talent Acquisition \| Sourcing \| Screening \| Interview Coordination \| Salary Negotiation \| Offer Management \| Employee Onboarding \| Recruitment MIS

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: HR Recruiter
description:
**ICON INFOLINE PVT. LTD. (IIPL)**

**Job Title:** IT Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Executive  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Location:** Pune  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time, On\-Site  
**Experience:** 1–2 Years, Interns can apply

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented **IT Recruiter** to join our HR team at Icon Infoline Pvt. Ltd. The candidate will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end recruitment for IT, technical, sales, support and other business positions.

The ideal candidate should have strong sourcing and screening skills, good knowledge of IT/technical profiles, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple positions and candidates simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the **end\-to\-end recruitment process** from requirement understanding to candidate joining.
* Understand job requirements from hiring managers and prepare or refine Job Descriptions accordingly.
* Source candidates through **Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, social media and other recruitment channels**.
* Identify and shortlist suitable candidates based on skills, experience, location, notice period and salary expectations.
* Conduct initial **HR screening and telephonic interviews**.
* Assess candidates for communication skills, stability, relevant experience and overall suitability.
* Coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds with the respective department heads.
* Maintain regular communication and follow\-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Manage candidate pipelines and ensure timely closure of open positions.
* Handle salary discussions, offer coordination and joining follow\-ups.
* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers, candidate databases and daily/weekly recruitment MIS.
* Ensure proper documentation of selected candidates before joining.
* Coordinate with HR for offer letters, joining formalities and onboarding.
* Develop and maintain a talent pool for frequently required IT and technical positions.
* Support bulk and urgent hiring requirements whenever required.
* Maintain a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment cycle.

Profiles You May Handle

Recruitment may include positions such as:

* IT Support / Technical Support
* Network Engineers
* System / Infrastructure Engineers
* IT Sales \& Business Development
* Software / Application\-related profiles
* Data / Technical roles
* Back Office \& Operations
* Other IT and business support positions

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Graduate degree in **HR, Business Administration, IT or a related field**.
* **1–2 years of experience in recruitment**, preferably IT/technical recruitment.
* Hands\-on experience with **Naukri and LinkedIn sourcing**.
* Good understanding of IT and technical job profiles.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good candidate screening and interviewing skills.
* Ability to handle multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Strong follow\-up, coordination and negotiation skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and recruitment trackers.
* Result\-oriented and comfortable working with recruitment targets and timelines.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of qualified profiles sourced and shortlisted.
* Interview\-to\-selection conversion.
* Offer\-to\-joining conversion.
* Recruitment turnaround time (TAT).
* Closure of assigned vacancies within timelines.
* Candidate database and tracker accuracy.
* Candidate follow\-up and joining ratio.

Preferred

* Experience in **IT Services / IT Infrastructure / Managed Services / Technical Support recruitment**.
* Experience handling multiple technical vacancies simultaneously.
* Knowledge of Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques.
* Experience with ATS/HRMS or recruitment management systems.

**Reporting To:** HR Head / Management

**Location:** Pune – Corporate Head Office

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: HR Recruiter
description:
**Job Title:** HR Recruiter

**Company:** Ingeniworx Business Solutions LLP

**Location:** Viman Nagar (Pune, Onsite)

**Work Hours:** 12:00 pm to 9:00 pm IST

**Job Description:**

We seek a dynamic and results\-driven HR Recruiter to join our team in Pune. The ideal candidate will manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process, source top talent, and ensure a seamless candidate experience. This role requires a strong understanding of recruitment strategies, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.

As an HR Recruiter, you will collaborate with hiring managers to identify staffing needs, develop job descriptions, and implement effective recruitment strategies to attract and retain the best talent. You will be key in building a strong employer brand and fostering a positive candidate journey.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Talent Acquisition:**

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing to onboarding. Utilize various channels (job portals, social media, referrals, etc.) to attract qualified candidates.
* Screen resumes, conduct initial interviews, and shortlist candidates for hiring managers.

**Stakeholder Collaboration:**

* Work closely with hiring managers to understand job requirements and team dynamics.
* Guide market trends, salary benchmarks, and recruitment best practices.

**Candidate Experience**:

* Ensure a positive and professional candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Communicate effectively with candidates, providing timely updates and feedback.

**Employer Branding:** 

* Promote the company’s employer brand through effective recruitment marketing strategies.
* Represent the company at campus drives and other recruitment events.

**Data Management:**

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date recruitment records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Generate recruitment reports and metrics to track progress and identify areas for improvement.

**Compliance:**

* Ensure all recruitment activities comply with local labor laws and company policies.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Additional HR certifications (e.g., SHRM, HRCI) are a plus.
* Minimum 1\-5 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition in the Indian market.
* Experience with volume hiring, technical recruitment, or niche roles is an advantage.
* Experience in recruiting for the US IT recruiters.
* Experience in recruiting technical positions.
* Familiarity with recruitment analytics and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment tools, ATS, and job portals (e.g., Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed).
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to multitask and work under tight deadlines.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and results\-oriented.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* High level of integrity and confidentiality.
* Fluency in English.

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Health insurance
* Paid leaves and holidays
* Growth\-oriented career path in a performance\-driven environment
* Work with a collaborative, high\-performing team

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (F/M) - Permanent - Pune
description:
#### **Shape the future of industrial transformation with We.PLM !**


Join We.PLM, a fast\-growing PLM consulting firm and Dassault Systèmes partner, supporting leading industrial companies across Western Europe. Our growth is driven by one thing: **delivering complex PLM transformations with deep technical excellence, on\-time delivery and proven reliability.**


With 50\+ certified consultants across Europe and India, we are building more than projects, we are building a **Centre of Excellence for PLM architecture and transformation.**


I’m Robin, HR Executive at We.PLM.


I’m searching a recruiter to elevate our talent acquisition in India.


This is where you come in.

#### **Your mission**


As a recruiter you are responsible for hiring best talents in time and offer a smooth candidate experience.


This role demands to support the structuration of recruitment and execute rigorously the policy.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Guarantee a clear reference frame in recruitment (recruitment policy, legal, key rules)
* Ensure every candidate has a good experience from hunt/application to onboarding
* Ensure managers apply successfully methodologies
* Support company in attractivity and employee brand
* Defining needs through a clear brief with managers
* Headhunting targeted profiles
* Assessing and evaluating candidates with a standard synthesis
* Support managers in decision making through debrief and score cards
* Ensuring every candidates get a feedback
* Pricing job offers

#### **You might be a great fit if…**

* You have a minimum of 5 years in recruitment including at least 3 years **headhunting** in PLM
* You have a bachelor or a master degree
* You are reliable, rigorous apply precisely methodologies and process defined
* You have an ability to synthesize information
* You conduct processes with proactivity, assertiveness and advisory approach to support managers
* You have good oral communication (clear, structured, concise \& synthetic, precise)
* You have good editorial communication

#### **Why joining We.PLM**

* A high\-expertise environment focused on delivery excellence
* Trainings, access to Dassault Systèmes University and DS certification
* Real career growth opportunities based on your ability to deliver impact and structure transformation
* Direct exposure to clients and strategic projects
* Close collaboration to experienced leaders and founders
* Attractive salary, based on your expertise
* Shared value bonus
* Health insurance
* Flexible working environment
* Strong team culture with team buildings

*Equal opportunities are a priority: we promote inclusion among our employees and provide appropriate accommodations.*

#### **Recruitment path**


HR interview


Manager interview


Final discussion with a director

**Simple. Fast. Transparent.**
